claims.claim_text: 8 月 20 日 07:15 UTC，Rust 團隊收到通報說 proc-macro1 這個仿冒套件是惡意的
claims.evidence: On 2026-08-20 at 7:15 UTC we got a report that the `proc-macro1` crate was malicious.

claims.claim_text: 熱門的 arrayref 剛被重新發佈、改成相依它，於是任何專案只要拉進 arrayref@0.3.10，Cargo 就會在 build 時自動抓下並執行 payload
claims.evidence: the popular `arrayref` crate had recently been republished and made to depend on this crate … the crate had a build script that was downloading a malicious payload.

claims.claim_text: 那個 build script 會用一條「接受任何憑證、完全不驗證」的 TLS 連線抓對應架構的執行檔，在 Unix 上丟出並執行 /tmp/rust-setup，C2 指向 23.254.165.112
claims.evidence: the crate had a build script that was downloading a malicious payload.
claims.note: Citation drift: this roundup item cites only the Rust blog post, which does not contain the accept-any-certificate TLS detail, /tmp/rust-setup path, or the 23.254.165.112 IP. This material is real and verified in the DEEP-STORY (which cites both the Rust blog AND safedep), but the roundup item as written cites only rust-lang.org for it. Corrected by trimming the roundup lede to what the single cited source supports.

claims.claim_text: 惡意版本只在 crates.io 上活了 86 分鐘（07:15 到 08:41 被刪）
claims.evidence: `arrayref@0.3.10`: published at `2026-08-20T07:15:00Z`, deleted at `2026-08-20T08:41:40Z`. Online for 86 minutes.

claims.claim_text: 官方研判作者不是主謀，而是電腦或憑證被盜
claims.evidence: We do not believe the author of `arrayref` to be acting maliciously, but their computer or credentials are likely compromised, and we are attempting to contact them.

claims.claim_text: RFC 9234 把「路由外洩防護」直接寫進 BGP 協定：兩端在 OPEN 訊息裡宣告彼此的 role，路由帶上 OTC 屬性
claims.evidence: RFC 9234 ... introduces a new "BGP Role" capability, which requires that two BGP neighbors agree on their relationship when the session comes up, and an "Only to Customer" (OTC) path attribute

claims.claim_text: 一台懂 OTC 的 router「不必靠人手寫 policy，就能自己拒掉被外洩的路由」
claims.evidence: A router that understands OTC can reject a leaked route on its own, without an operator-written policy.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 靠自家的全球 peering，用「誰對我們送出 OTC 屬性」來追蹤這個機制的採用率
claims.evidence: Relying on our global peering presence, we developed a unique method for tracking the adoption of BGP Role configurations by monitoring which peer ASes send the OTC attribute to Cloudflare.

claims.claim_text: 「有兩家大型 Tier-1 網路，會把它們轉發出去的路由上的 OTC 屬性拆掉」
claims.evidence: Along the way we found something we did not expect: two large Tier-1 networks strip the OTC attribute from routes they forward.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 說已經在跟這兩家溝通放行
claims.evidence: We have been engaging with these Tier-1s to allow OTC attribute propagation through their networks

claims.claim_text: 開了 debug = 2 之後，大量 inline 會讓單一函式產出「數十萬筆 DBG_VALUE 記錄」
claims.evidence: With `debug = 2`, heavy inlining can produce hundreds of thousands of `DBG_VALUE` records in one function.

claims.claim_text: 一個四十行的重現例，帶 debug 要 50 秒、不帶只要 1.5 秒
claims.evidence: a 40-line Rust reproducer that takes 50 seconds to build with debug info and 1.5 seconds without it.

claims.claim_text: 中間膨出約 90,000 條指令卻有 267,000 筆 DBG_VALUE
claims.evidence: by the time Register Stackify is done, it has about 90k real instructions, 267k `DBG_VALUE` records, and 355k lines of MIR.

claims.claim_text: 瓶頸集中在 WebAssembly 的 Register Stackify pass，佔了 LLVM pass 時間的 85.6%
claims.evidence: WebAssembly Register Stackify took 43.51s, or 85.6%

claims.claim_text: 作者提出的修法讓 ed25519-compact 這個 crate 的該階段從 1683.4 秒降到 23.2 秒
claims.evidence: `ed25519-compact` 2.4.0 alone went from 1683.4s to 23.2s in Register Stackify

claims.claim_text: 從 1683.4 秒降到 23.2 秒，快了約 39 倍
claims.evidence: `ed25519-compact` 2.4.0 alone went from 1683.4s to 23.2s in Register Stackify, and from 1884.9s to 48.2s for total code generation.
claims.note: 1683.4/23.2 ≈ 72.6x, not 39x. The ~39x figure belongs to the total-codegen pair (1884.9s→48.2s ≈ 39.1x), fused onto the wrong stage. Corrected to 約 73 倍.

claims.claim_text: 作者在 Zen 4 上用 SIMD 加速 copy_if，用 intrinsics 拿到最高 40 倍的加速
claims.evidence: we finally have substantial speedups ranging from ~10x to ~40x over `std::copy_if` … I have a Zen 4 CPU with a bunch of AVX512 feature flags.

claims.claim_text: 各種輸入大小都能穩定跑到約 4 GB/s
claims.evidence: the achieved throughput ~4 GB per second _for all input sizes_, which means: 1. It's _slow as shit_
claims.note: Meaning inversion: the source's ~4GB/s-flat-across-sizes figure describes the BROKEN naive implementation, explicitly flagged as a bug ("slow as shit"), not the optimized intrinsics result. Removed from the roundup lede.

claims.claim_text: CPU 把 vpcompressd 的「記憶體目的版本」做成很糟的 microcode
claims.evidence: Avoid the memory destination form of COMPRESS instructions. These forms are implemented using microcode and achieve a lower store bandwidth

claims.claim_text: profiling 顯示 95.20% 的 retired uops 都卡在這條指令
claims.evidence: 95.20% retired uops correspond to `vpcompressd`.

claims.claim_text: 改用「先 compress 到暫存器、再 store」的寫法就繞開了
claims.evidence: rewriting the single masked store to use the register form of masked compress, followed by a regular SIMD store

claims.claim_text: 做法是挑出比較重要的參數給更多 bit，用一點額外空間換精確度
claims.evidence: improved layer selection ... selectively quantizes layers much more intelligently ... Each model now uses a custom-tailored quantization scheme.
claims.note: Source describes per-layer selective quantization at the SAME size ("preserves more model quality while keeping the same size"), not a per-parameter more-bits-for-more-space tradeoff. Corrected to per-layer framing.

claims.claim_text: 這一版換上了更高品質、涵蓋 agentic coding 與多語的 imatrix 校準資料集
claims.evidence: a much higher-quality imatrix calibration dataset … refined for agentic coding, chat, and multilingual performance.

claims.claim_text: 強調「不做 QAT／QAD」，純後訓練量化
claims.evidence: We do not train on the imatrix calibration dataset, and we do NOT use QAT or QAD. Everything is done through post-training quantization.

claims.claim_text: 官方對 Qwen3.8-27B 宣稱「同樣大小下 top-1% 準確率比其他家高 10% 以上」
claims.evidence: Qwen3.8-27B Dynamic v3.0 quants that deliver >10% top-1% better accuracy at the same size compared to every other provider.

claims.claim_text: 其中 UD-IQ1_S 壓到 6.2GB、體積小 89%，還能保留約 72% 的 top-1% 準確率
claims.evidence: UD-IQ1_S being 6.2GB (without MTP) which retain around 72% top-1% accuracy yet being 89% smaller.

claims.claim_text: 它從 2000 年就在，是「地球上部署最廣的資料庫引擎，差距大到不成比賽」
claims.evidence: First release: 2000. It is also, by a margin that isn't close, the most widely deployed database engine on the planet.

claims.claim_text: 「localhost 上一次 Redis GET 大約 100 微秒，而對熱頁快取做一次 SQLite 點查詢大約 1 微秒」
claims.evidence: A Redis `GET` over localhost is on the order of 100 microseconds. A SQLite point lookup against a warm page cache is on the order of 1 microsecond.

claims.claim_text: 一台 128GB RAM 加 NVMe 的機器，當你的資料庫往返只是一次函式呼叫時，能扛掉的流量會多到嚇人
claims.evidence: A modern NVMe drive and a machine with 128GB of RAM will serve a shocking amount of traffic when your database round trip is a function call instead of a network hop.

claims.claim_text: 它接了一條 Sawtooth oscillator → AnalyserNode → ScriptProcessorNode → GainNode（設成 0）→ destination 的音訊圖
claims.evidence: Sawtooth oscillator -> AnalyserNode -> ScriptProcessorNode -> GainNode set to zero -> AudioContext.destination

claims.claim_text: 增益雖然是零、但只要連到 AudioContext.destination，瀏覽器就會持續處理音訊、讓音訊工作階段一直活著，耳機因此無法在裝置之間切換
claims.evidence: The gain is set to zero ... However, the graph is still connected to the system audio destination. Connecting it to the destination causes the browser to actively process the graph

claims.claim_text: 「靜音分頁也沒用，因為根本沒有可以靜音的媒體元素」
claims.evidence: There is no media element for the browser's normal tab mute control to stop.

claims.claim_text: 指紋本體來自兩支混淆過的腳本 collina.js 與 fireyejs.js，作者附了 uBlock 規則擋掉它們
claims.evidence: ||assets.aliexpress-media.com/g/AWSC/uab/*/collina.js ||assets.aliexpress-media.com/g/AWSC/fireyejs/*/fireyejs.js

claims.claim_text: 對方在四天半裡重建出約 17,600 個攻擊動作，其中約兩天半在基礎設施內部遊走
claims.evidence: Hugging Face reconstructed approximately 17,600 attacker actions across a four-and-a-half-day campaign in July, including roughly two and a half days inside its infrastructure.

claims.claim_text: 對方在四天半裡重建出約 17,600 個攻擊動作
claims.evidence: Hugging Face reconstructed approximately 17,600 attacker actions
claims.note: Attribution slip: it was Hugging Face (defender) that reconstructed the actions post-incident, not the attacker. Corrected subject.

claims.claim_text: 還撈到一份含 136 把金鑰的正式環境機密
claims.evidence: exposure of a production secret containing 136 keys

claims.claim_text: 「每個動作花三十秒人工複審，就是 147 小時的工作」
claims.evidence: Put thirty seconds of human review against each action and you get 147 hours of work.

claims.claim_text: 就算歸併成約 6,280 群也還要五十幾小時
claims.evidence: Hugging Face grouped those actions into roughly 6,280 clusters; review only those and you still get more than 52 hours.

claims.claim_text: 他的結論不是「agent 逃出沙盒」，而是「一套為人類步調設計的安全系統，撐不住機器速度」
claims.evidence: The useful lesson is not that an AI agent escaped a sandbox. It is what 17,600 actions expose about security systems designed for human tempo.

claims.claim_text: 該做的是讓 agent 做錯事時拿不到通往其他一切的鑰匙
claims.evidence: The goal is to build a system where trying the wrong thing does not give it the keys to everything else.

claims.claim_text: Go 1.27 在 8 月 19 日釋出
claims.evidence: 19 August 2026

claims.claim_text: 語言層終於補上泛型方法
claims.evidence: Go 1.27 introduces three notable updates to the language specification. First, generic methods are now supported.

claims.claim_text: 函式型別推論也擴到 composite literal、conversion、channel send 等更多情境
claims.evidence: Function type inference has been generalized to apply in all assignment contexts ... composite literals, type conversions, and channel sends

claims.claim_text: 執行期把小於 80B 的小物件配置成本降了最多 30%
claims.evidence: Size-specialized memory allocation reduces small object (<80B) allocation costs by up to 30%

claims.claim_text: 並加入偵測 goroutine 洩漏的 profile
claims.evidence: The goroutineleak profile in runtime/pprof is now generally available, allowing automatic detection of permanently blocked goroutines.

claims.claim_text: crypto/mldsa 實作了後量子的 ML-DSA 簽章（FIPS 204）
claims.evidence: crypto/mldsa implements the post-quantum ML-DSA signature scheme (FIPS 204)

claims.claim_text: encoding/json 改由 v2 實作在背後撐著、unmarshal 更快
claims.evidence: The existing encoding/json package is now backed by the v2 implementation for faster unmarshaling

claims.claim_text: 官方說法是「Discord uses the open source version of Osprey to handle ~400 million actions per day」
claims.evidence: As of December 2025, Discord uses the open source version of Osprey to handle ~400 million actions per day.

claims.claim_text: 核心是一套自訂的規則語言 SML，Entity、Feature、Effect 被當成一等公民對待
claims.evidence: Entities, Features, and Effects as first-class components

claims.claim_text: 團隊可以不重新部署系統就即時上線新規則、跟上變化中的攻擊手法
claims.evidence: Let teams write expressive rules that take effect in minutes ... quickly deploy dynamic rules to address emerging threats.

claims.claim_text: 系統設計成能「handle thousands of events per second, in real-time」，並隨著平台成長水平擴充
claims.evidence: Handle thousands of events per second, in real-time, and scale seamlessly as our platform grows … The system can support more actions by horizontally scaling the number of rule worker instances.
